// diagnostic E0612

Jet.WildcardImport

Wildcard imports (`use math.*`) are not supported

What

Wildcard imports (`use math.*`) are not supported

Why

A wildcard import would hide where each name comes from

Fix

Replace `use math.*` with explicit imports such as `use math.sqrt`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.WildcardImport: Tests/UI/module_wildcard.stderr.

Error: Jet.WildcardImport: Wildcard imports are not supported
  --> Tests/UI/module_wildcard.jet:7:10
    |
  7 | use math.*
    |          ^
 Why: `use math.*` would hide where each name comes from
 Fix: List each item instead: `use math.[item, other]`
